newsitem.title: USA: Nextel says McCaw family exercises option.
newsitem.headline: Nextel says McCaw family exercises option.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc. said Tuesday that Craig McCaw and his family had invested an additional $232.5 million in the wireless phone company by exercising an option to buy 15 million shares of Nextel stock.
The McCaw family's investment in McLean, Va.-based Nextel is now about $600 million, the company said.
Craig McCaw sold his family's cellular phone business to AT&T Corp. in 1994 for about $15.7 billion in one of the biggest corporate mergers in history.
No shares in addition to the option shares were issued in conjunction with the purchase, said Nextel.
Nextel stock rose $1.06 to $22.75 in afternoon trading on Nasdaq.
